'''Master Hamm''' (Japanese:  '''ハマグリ''' ''Hamaguri'') is a [[character of the day]] who appeared in ''[[AG145|Pasta La Vista]]''. He is the owner of the [[Fighting Dojo]] in [[Saffron City]].

He tried to convince his son [[Kyle Hamm]] to run the dojo since he claimed that he was too old to do it, though Kyle refused to do so. So they challenged each other to a match. If Kyle won, he would be free to do whatever he wants, including his wish to run his own noodle shop. Since Master Hamm injured his back, {{Ash}} took his place, while {{an|May}} took over for Kyle. When they battled, {{TRT}} interrupted the match and captured {{p|Hitmonlee}} and {{p|Hitmonchan}}. [[Terri]], the only student of the dojo, subsequently used {{p|Hitmontop}} to battle them. Ash finished them off with {{AP|Pikachu}}'s {{m|Thunderbolt}}.

Afterwards, Master Hamm conceded after realizing Kyle's noodle restaurant dream was inspired by his own cooking. Master Hamm also revealed that he wanted to travel around making noodles, so he handed the Fighting Dojo to Terri, fulfilling her dreams.
